AEON opens Kawaguchi Higashi XD with mixed-load robotic handling

Mujin links case sequencing, robot arms and human work from store sorting through mixed-load cart stacking.

AEON / PR TIMES ↗29 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 12

Operations begin

AEON, AEON Global SCM and Mujin began operating Kawaguchi Higashi XD in Saitama on October 29 under their 2023 partnership. AEON describes it as its first connected automation of store-specific sorting and mixed-load stacking, serving small urban supermarkets.

Planning meets feedback

The system simulates a stacking plan from shipment orders and uses 3D vision to inspect loads while placing goods on carts. It adjusts motion when boxes shift or the stack changes. Supporting equipment includes sequencing shuttles, depalletizing robots and AGVs linked to fixed-position picking.

Coordinating people and machines

The WES schedules supply, equipment activity and handheld instructions for workers against each store’s deadline, while exposing progress and utilization. The announcement provides no measured post-opening labor or cost reduction, so the new center’s return on investment remains unquantified.
